I worry sometimes that I have not been a good mum to my children because I spend much less time with them compared to other mums that work less.
</message>
output: I guess what I really want is to know they feel loved even if I'm not around as much, and it scares me that time is the thing I can't give more of. I think I compare myself to other mums and always come up short in my own head, even if the kids never actually say they feel neglected. Maybe I just need to hear that being present isn't only about hours, because right now I don't quite believe that myself.
